verdict.rationale: Close's MCP server documents an `mcp.write_destructive` scope that can read, write, and delete data, so programmatic deletion of CRM records is a first-party capability. The pricing page lists "unlimited call recording retention" only as a plan feature, not as a user-configurable retention control. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies or retention windows, documented account/record purge or GDPR-style deletion workflows, deletion endpoint documentation, and independent corroboration.
